correctness.rationale: The common monic quadratic confines all critical coordinate values to two; explicit two-block derivative identities plus p not dividing n-2 exclude two nonzero values and force indicator support m congruent 1 mod p. The Hessian is block diagonal I_m-J_m and J_l-I_l with rank n-1 and radial kernel; this is a full-rank projective Jacobian and proves reducedness and nodality. Euler identity for p>3 and Frobenius binomial mod 3 for p=3 give the singular subset; Serre criterion proves normality for n>=4. Finite exhaustive Fp checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the reduced projective critical scheme and of all geometric nodes in a family of symmetric cubic hypersurfaces over arbitrary odd prime characteristics. Xie explicitly leaves complete smaller-dimensional components/global reducedness open, and characteristic three exhibits a substantive split between critical and singular points. Counts grow combinatorially (e.g. 36 nodes for p=5,n=8) and normality is settled; not an arbitrary finite slice or cheap arithmetic substitution.
